doc.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Copenhagen recordings, interests and views on the music
title: First SteepleChase albums and recording with Dexter Gordon
summary: With Alex Riel on drums, McLean made live albums, and brought in Dexter, his giant, for The Meeting and The Source.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Yeah. Then, when Nils said to me, “Jackie, you can bring anybody you want to play these albums,” these two, man, I hurried up and told them to get Dexter, because that was who I wanted.
That’s these two. One you call The Source. The first one you call The Meeting.
Yeah. I didn’t name those. He named those. I didn’t name them.
How much did it mean for you to get with Dexter?

Ooo, that was my giant. That was my big giant that I always loved from the beginning. That was a great moment, for me to play with him, to record with him. I had played with him before. But to make these recordings – this cat is so bad.
So you made the things with Dexter.
Yeah, I made the two recordings, and I made all those records with that label.
